what_it_measured.text: Prospective Activity of PLG0206, an Engineered Antimicrobial Peptide, on Chronic Periprosthetic Joint Infection Total Knee Arthroplasty Components Ex Vivo: The Knee Explant Analysis (KnEA) Study

dose.text: IMPORTANCE Chronically infected prosthetics of the knee were exposed to PLG0206, an engineered antimicrobial peptide, at a concentration of 1 mg/mL for 15 min.

endpoint.text: At a concentration of 1 mg/mL for 15 min, there was a mean 4-log10 reduction (range, 1 to 7) in the bacterial CFU identiﬁed from the implants.

reported_results.text: A mean 4log10 reduction (range, 1 to 7) in the number of bacteria occurred, which may translate to improved clinical outcomes for persons with prosthetic joint infection of the knee.

numbers.text: IMPORTANCE Chronically infected prosthetics of the knee were exposed to PLG0206, an engineered antimicrobial peptide, at a concentration of 1 mg/mL for 15 min.

A mean 4log10 reduction (range, 1 to 7) in the number of bacteria occurred, which may translate to improved clinical outcomes for persons with prosthetic joint infection of the knee.
